welcome.title: Welcome to the Climate Action Navigator (CAN)
welcome.description: CAN is your entry point to exploring climate solutions at the local level. CAN offers high-resolution data and insights on key climate indicators, from heating emissions to walkability, helping you identify both strengths and areas for improvement in your city or region.

notes.title: A few notes before you begin…
notes.onDemand: CAN results are calculated on-demand. This reduces our energy consumption, but means that assessments may take up to 60 minutes during high traffic.
notes.urbanAreas: Our tools are at their best in urban areas, where open data is most readily available. Results in rural areas may vary.
notes.experts: While CAN is open to everyone, our assessment tools are tailored to experts. As such, they may include technical terms.
notes.worksInProgress: All tools and assessments within CAN are continuously updated as new methods and datasets become available. Check back regularly for new and improved features.

tourChoiceDialog.title: Let's get started!
tourChoiceDialog.description: To get the most out of this walkthrough, we recommend logging in first. However, you can also try a shorter guest walkthrough to see what the platform offers.
tourChoiceDialog.guestNote: The guest walkthrough provides a preview of what the platform offers, utilising demo data.

choosePlugin.title: Choose an Assessment Tool
choosePlugin.description: Let's start by picking from one of the many assessment tools. We'll use hiWalk for this example.

newComputation.title: Request a New Computation
newComputation.description: Next we'll click on the New Computation button to initiate a new request.

searchArea.title: Search for an Area of Interest
searchArea.description: Now we'll have to go to the area of interest. We've prefilled the search with an example for you. Click on the suggestion that appears to go there on the map.

selectBoundary.title: Select the area boundary
selectBoundary.description: Now select the area boundaries by clicking on the map. You can also zoom in and out to see the area boundaries better.

requestCompute.title: Request the computation
requestCompute.description: Finally, click on the Compute button to start the computation.

openComputation.descriptionFull: The computation is now ready! Let's expand it to see what results are available.
openComputation.descriptionGuest: Next, let's open the Demo computation that has been pre-loaded for you.

viewFirstResult.title: View a result
viewFirstResult.description: Let's open the first result to see what it contains.

exploreResult.title: Read more about the results
exploreResult.description: You can read more about the results, or even download the raw data from here.

viewChartResult.title: View a different result
viewChartResult.description: Not all results are displayed on the map. Let's look at a chart in this result.

completion.title: Done!
completion.descriptionGuest: This concludes the guest tour. You may request your own custom computations for any area of interest after logging in. You can restart this walkthrough anytime from the Account menu.
completion.descriptionFull: The walkthrough is now complete. Feel free to explore the other Assessment Tools and see what they can offer. You can always restart this walkthrough via the Account menu.
